title: TrueNorth shared definitions
description: Reusable $defs shared by every TrueNorth content schema. This file defines no root shape; it is referenced, never validated against.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, unique within its collection.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: A supported UI locale. EN and FR ship from the first commit.

localizedText.title: Localized text
localizedText.description: A string in every supported locale. Both EN and FR are mandatory.

vec2.title: 2D vector
vec2.description: A point or size in design-resolution pixels (1080x1920).
